name: Bharat Dynamics Ltd
about: Bharat Dynamics (BDL), is a Government of India Enterprise. It is engaged in the manufacturing of guided missiles and allied defence equipments [1] [2].
keyPoints: Product Portfolio[1] [2] The company is a defence manufacturer with capabilities in producing and supplying guided missile systems, underwater weapons, airborne products, and other defence equipment for the Indian Armed Forces. Its key products include SAMs/AAMs, ATGMs, torpedoes, launchers, countermeasure systems, underwater decoys, and test/monitoring equipment, covering systems like Akash, Medium Range SAM, ULPGM, Astra, Milan-2T, Konkurs-M, INVAR, NAG, and lightweight/heavyweight torpedoes.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 35.1%
cons: Stock is trading at 8.29 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.99% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 13.9% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.487 Cr.

announcements.text: Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30 Sep 2026 12 Nov - Bharat Dynamics approved Q2/H1 FY26 results; net profit rose to ₹183.48 crore and ₹302.27 crore.

Board Meeting Intimation for Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30 Sep 2026 4 Nov - Board meeting on 12 Nov 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year unaudited results; trading window closed from 1 Oct 2026.

Compliances-Reg. 50 (1) - Prior intimation about Board meeting under Regulation 50(1) 4 Nov - Board meeting on 12 Nov 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year FY2026 results; trading window closed from 1 Oct.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 16 Oct - Dr. Jagannath Nayak appointed Government Nominee Director on BDL board effective 16 October 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Award_of_Order_Receipt_of_Order 15 Oct - BDL signed a ₹1,307 crore contract with Indian Navy for heavyweight torpedoes, to be completed in 42 months.
